Captain America: The First Avenger.content:
During World War II, Steve Rogers volunteers for an experiment that turns him into Captain America. When an old friend is captured behind enemy lines, Steve sets out with a rescue team and discovers that HYDRA is developing weapons with the Tesseract.

The wartime story introduces the Tesseract and Peggy Carter. It also explains why Steve is able to meet the other Avengers decades later.

Iron Man.content:
Weapons manufacturer Tony Stark is taken captive after a demonstration in Afghanistan. He and fellow prisoner Ho Yinsen build a powered suit that lets Tony escape. Back home, Tony develops the design and turns against his company’s weapons business.

Tony’s decision puts him at odds with his business partner Obadiah Stane. The film introduces Pepper Potts and James Rhodes, and its credits scene introduces the Avengers Initiative.

The Avengers.content:
When Loki steals the Tesseract, Nick Fury brings together a team that includes Iron Man, Captain America, Thor and the Hulk. Black Widow and Hawkeye join the fight as Loki opens a portal over New York City.

The Battle of New York is a turning point in the shared story. It establishes the Avengers and becomes a reference point for later films and series.

Avengers: Endgame.content:
Five years after Thanos’s Snap, the surviving Avengers discover a way to revisit earlier moments in their history. They split up to retrieve the Infinity Stones and attempt to restore the people who vanished.

The aftermath sets up WandaVision and The Falcon and the Winter Soldier. One trip back to the Battle of New York also creates the branch explored in Loki.

WandaVision.content:
Wanda Maximoff and Vision live in a suburb that changes to resemble sitcoms from different decades. As neighbors and visitors disrupt the routine, the pair begin to question how their seemingly ordinary life came to be.

The main story takes place weeks after Endgame. It follows Wanda’s response to those events and introduces characters who return in later MCU productions.

Loki.content:
A Loki variant escapes with the Tesseract during the Avengers’ visit to 2012. The Time Variance Authority arrests him and recruits him to investigate disturbances across branching realities.

The story follows the variant and the TVA outside a single ordinary Earth date. The two seasons have separate entries on the chronology because their events follow one another on the branch timeline.
